question: Why do LSM-Trees (Log-Structured Merge-Trees) provide higher write throughput than B+ Trees?
category: Why do LSM-Trees (Log-Structured Merge-Trees) provide higher write throughput than B+ Trees?

options.text: LSM-Trees convert random writes into sequential writes by buffering in memory (MemTable) and writing sequential immutable SSTables to disk.
